post.description: List all Amazon Live broadcasts for a specific channel. Returns paginated broadcast details filtered by channelId. Use this when you know the channel and want all its broadcasts.
Delete an Amazon Live broadcast by its broadcastId. This permanently removes the broadcast and cannot be undone. Only broadcasts that are not currently LIVE can be deleted.

Validate promotion codes by querying Amazon's promotions system. Required: broadcastId filter and promoCode filter (up to 10 codes). Returns validated promo code details including discount percentage, validity window, and associated product IDs (ASINs). Use this to check if a promo code exists and is valid before associating it with a broadcast.

List carousel items (products or landing pages) shown during an Amazon Live broadcast. Returns display order, activation status, carousel type (PRODUCT or CUSTOM), and metadata such as product ID or landing page details. Use this to see what items are being showcased during a broadcast.

Create a new Amazon Live broadcast scheduled on a specific channel. Required: title, channelId. Optional: scheduledStartDateTime, videoSource, streamingOrientation, isPublic, isPractice, includesDeals. Returns the created broadcast with a server-assigned broadcastId and initial broadcastStatus. Practice broadcasts (isPractice=true) are test broadcasts that do not appear to end viewers.

Update existing carousel items (products or landing pages) in an Amazon Live broadcast. Supports bulk update up to 45 items per call. Required per item: carouselItemId. Only provided fields are modified; others remain unchanged. The type field is immutable after creation. Use isActive=false to hide an item without deleting it.

Update an existing Amazon Live broadcast. Required: broadcastId. Only provided fields are modified; others remain unchanged. CAUTION: broadcastStatus transitions are significant - moving to LIVE starts the stream, moving to COMPLETED ends it permanently. Prefer the dedicated go-live and end-broadcast workflows over direct status updates when possible.

Create a media asset (thumbnail, sponsored image, HLS stream, MP4 video, or video clip) associated with an Amazon Live broadcast. Required: broadcastId, type, and at least one of content or metadata (either a binary upload or a metadata record must be supplied). Server assigns mediaAssetId, format, url, and version on creation. Use appropriate type: THUMBNAIL_IMAGE, SPONSORED_IMAGE, HLS_STREAM, MP4_VIDEO, VIDEO_CLIP.

List promotion codes associated with an Amazon Live broadcast. Returns promo code details including the code string, discount percentage, start/end times, and associated product IDs (ASINs). Use this to see what deals are offered during a broadcast.

Update an existing Amazon Live channel. Required: channelId. Only provided fields are modified; others remain unchanged. channelState, followers, featureFlags, and streamDetailIds are managed by the system and cannot be updated via this tool.

Update an existing promo code association on an Amazon Live broadcast. Required: id. Only the associated promo code string and broadcast can be updated here; discount percentage, validity window, and product IDs are derived from the promotions system.

Update an existing broadcast media asset's metadata or content. Required: mediaAssetId. Only provided fields are modified. mediaAssetId, url, format, creationDateTime, and version are server-managed and immutable.

Query Amazon Live channels for a brand. Returns channel details including title, follower count, state (OFFLINE/PREVIEWING/LIVE), feature flags, and associated stream IDs. Use this to find channels owned by a brand.
Retrieve a specific promotion code by its id. Returns full promo code details including the code string, discount percentage, validity window, and associated product IDs.
Retrieve a specific Amazon Live channel by its channelId. Returns full channel details including title, follower count, logo URL, state, feature flags, and associated stream detail IDs.

Create a new Amazon Live channel for a brand. A channel is the persistent home for a brand's livestreams. Required: title, brandId. Optional: brandAlternateIds, logoUrl. Returns the created channel with a server-assigned channelId and initial channelState (OFFLINE).

List livestream technical details (streaming infrastructure) for an Amazon Live channel. Returns ingest endpoint, ingest type (WEBRTC/RTMPS/SRT), preview URL, stream state (bitrate/resolution/frame rate), and validation status. Stream keys are NOT included in list responses. Use this to inspect the streaming setup for a channel.

Query Amazon Live broadcasts for a brand. Supports filtering by brand ID, brand alternate IDs, creation date range, and broadcast status (UNSCHEDULED, SCHEDULED, PRE_LIVE, LIVE, COMPLETED). Returns paginated broadcast details including title, status, scheduled times, and channel association. Use this to find broadcasts matching specific criteria.

List all Amazon Live channels for the current advertiser account. No filters required — returns all channels the advertiser has access to, including channelId, title, state (OFFLINE/PREVIEWING/LIVE), logo URL, and feature flags. Use this as the starting point to discover which channels exist before querying broadcasts or livestream details.

List media assets (thumbnails, sponsored images, HLS streams, MP4 videos, video clips) associated with an Amazon Live broadcast. Returns asset type, URL, format, and metadata such as dimensions, orientation, and duration.

Create carousel items (products or landing pages) to be shown during an Amazon Live broadcast. Supports bulk create up to 45 items per call. Required per item: broadcastId, type (PRODUCT or CUSTOM), carouselMetadata. For PRODUCT type, provide ProductCarouselMetadata with productId (ASIN). For CUSTOM type, provide LandingPageCarouselMetadata with title and description; linkUrl and imageUrl are optional. Returns created items with server-assigned carouselItemIds.

Associate a promotion code with an Amazon Live broadcast. The promo code string must already exist in the Amazon promotions system. Required: broadcastId, promoCode. The discount percentage, validity window, and associated product IDs are derived from the promo code in the promotions system and cannot be set directly here. Returns the created association with a server-assigned id.

Retrieve a specific Amazon Live broadcast by its broadcastId. Returns full broadcast details including status, scheduling, chat details, moderation events, carousel item IDs, media asset IDs, and promo code IDs. Use the dedicated list tools (list_carousel_items, list_broadcast_media_assets, list_promo_codes) to retrieve full details for these associated resources.
